Rails.application.routes.draw do
  devise_for :users, controllers: {
    omniauth_callbacks: 'users/omniauth_callbacks'
  }
  
  get 'dashboard', to: 'dashboard#index'
  get 'reports', to: 'reports#index'
  
  resources :transactions do
    member do
      get :pdf_export
      get :word_export
      get :excel_export
      post :duplicate
    end
    
    # Create child transactions from parent detail page
    member do
      get 'children/new', to: 'transactions#new_child', as: :new_child
      post 'children', to: 'transactions#create_child', as: :create_child
    end

    # Email functionality
    resources :emails, controller: 'transaction_emails', only: [:new, :create]

    # Nested routes for attachments
    resources :attachments, except: [:index] do
      member do
        get :download
      end
    end
  end
  # Define your application routes per the DSL in https://guides.rubyonrails.org/routing.html


  # Reveal health status on /up that returns 200 if the app boots with no exceptions, otherwise 500.
  # Can be used by load balancers and uptime monitors to verify that the app is live.
  get "up" => "rails/health#show", as: :rails_health_check

  # Render dynamic PWA files from app/views/pwa/* (remember to link manifest in application.html.erb)
  # get "manifest" => "rails/pwa#manifest", as: :pwa_manifest
  # get "service-worker" => "rails/pwa#service_worker", as: :pwa_service_worker

  # Defines the root path route ("/")
  root "home#index"
end
